resources.string: Stroke thickness of key labels, 400 is regular, 700 is bold. Requires Android 9.
Antialias text, icons and borders. Off keeps the keyboard pure black and white, which looks crisper in fast refresh modes.
Fill the key while it is held. When off, only vibration confirms a press.
Draw emoji in the keyboard with a monochrome font. Emoji missing from it are converted to black and white. Inserted emoji still appear in color in the app.
Black and white emoji: Noto Emoji by Google, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Hisense A9: clear screen when keyboard hides
Run a full refresh to remove ghosting after the keyboard closes. Requires A9 Accessibility Service with “Allow Control via Broadcasts” enabled.
Hisense A9: fast refresh while typing

Switch the panel to Speed mode while the keyboard is shown and restore the app\'s mode afterwards. Requires A9 Accessibility Service 3.8.1-colors.2 or newer with “Allow Control via Broadcasts” enabled.
